description: Unsigned transaction settling a series after its Friday 8pm New York expiry with the feed's last round at or before it, found by walking back from the latest round, once the proof holds (the next round printed after expiry, or it is the feed's latest); when the feed printed nothing in the two days before expiry, with its first round after. Gives the settlement price and what it pays a share. Fourteen days after expiry with no round to prove a price it builds void(id) instead. Anyone may send either.

series_id.description: The series id (or symbol, expiry, strike and type instead)

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The address that will send it (any address)

name: settle_series
title: Prepare: settle an expired series
